column3: Turns the closed Session-row "..." menu and hover buttons into two root-scoped `list` slots that ui-workspace fills with its own pin/rename/fork/archive actions, ordered by `order`, with `separatorBefore` on the entry replacing an owner-drawn extension group.
Chinese mirror of the session-row slot note (36 lines); same slot ids, same order numbers, same five rejected alternatives; translates the canonical headings into 问题/决策/考虑过的替代方案/后果.

Official settings pages move to client-only companion packages that register into `plugins.item` only while `settingsScope.whileServed(namespaces, register)` sees the Host serving their namespace; the form kit (`SettingsFormModel`, `SettingsForm`) moves to `ui-primitives`.

Chinese mirror of the companion-packages note (41 lines); adds that the shell page's `plugins.item` id changed from `bash` to `shell` (line 37) and that the cookbook path is adding-a-settings-card.zh.md.

Archived bilingual-pair sidecar: whole-file git blob hashes for both languages of this note (b9a2144.../881bca1..., lines 5-6) plus the `verify-translation-pairing --write <pair>` re-record command (line 4).

Moves Office manifest validation, interpreter paths and the model query into `tool-workspace-dependencies` and the payload builder into `scripts/primary-runtime/prepare.ts`, so SDK carriers get the same runtime without Desktop's packaging/signing code; `runtime.json` holds flat versions plus `pythonPackages`.

Chinese mirror of the shared-Office-runtime note (38 lines); same flat-field/`pythonPackages` manifest rules and the same guarantee that copy mode restores the preceding installation after a failed publication (line 36).
Archived bilingual-pair sidecar: blob hashes 92ef99a.../ce11888... for the shared-office-runtime pair (lines 5-6), re-record command naming the English file (line 4).

Every feature route keeps an absolute `*_PATH` key and derives a document-relative `*_ROUTE` for the browser; `verify-client-route-resolution` statically rejects root-absolute/protocol-relative app routes and `location`-resolved relative routes in request targets.
Chinese mirror of the route-gate note (32 lines); same gate rules plus the stated limit that only inline literal fragments are traced (line 28).
Archived bilingual-pair sidecar: blob hashes eb9e6d9.../27951c4... for the web-feature-routes pair (lines 5-6).

Collapses the Agent Teams and Agent Teams Web switches into one optional bundle whose patch keeps the `agent-team`/`tool-agent-team`/`ui-agent-team` row ids; records the startup-failure upgrade gap for profiles still selecting the removed Web bundle.
Chinese mirror of the single-bundle note (34 lines); same inert-Host-entry rule (line 14) and the same named upgrade compatibility gap (line 30).
Archived bilingual-pair sidecar: blob hashes 99f51cd.../a386029... for the agent-teams pair (lines 5-6).

Virtualizes the fixed-10px turn rail with TanStack React Virtual, splits chat scrolling into viewport/reading/navigation owners, and buffers paged history so one jump publishes one ordered prepend instead of P; includes a labelled theoretical O() work model.
Chinese mirror of the chat-navigation note (62 lines) carrying the same O() work-model table; keeps the canonical skeleton headings in English and translates only the bespoke `###` sections.
Archived bilingual-pair sidecar: blob hashes c9f7ab7.../f410999... for the chat-navigation pair (lines 5-6).

Plugins declare `meta.title`/`meta.description` in `locale/<lang>.json`, resolved through Node package exports without evaluating plugin code; per-field fallback to package.json then the full specifier, with file/UNC paths returning no metadata.
Chinese mirror of the localized-metadata note (92 lines); same per-field fallback table (lines 39-44) and the same "no metadata cache" consequence (line 90).
Archived bilingual-pair sidecar: blob hashes 7d57a1b.../7bbea03... for the localized-package-metadata pair (lines 5-6), the longest note in the shard.

Cross-instance identity must come from a peerDependency (hoisted profile + autoInstallPeers:false -> the installation's single instance), because `dsh-scope` compares a module-local Symbol and `dsh-mcp-client` keeps module-local serverName reservations.

Chinese mirror of the host-runtime-instances note (38 lines); same peer-dependency rule (line 16) and the same open follow-up, issue #4628, for three sibling providers that still depend on `dsh-mcp-client`.
Archived bilingual-pair sidecar: blob hashes 2f1ae23.../3365d2b... for the profile-plugin-host-runtime pair (lines 5-6).

Checkpoint values validate with the existing `isJsonValue` predicate instead of `z.json()`, because Zod's object rebuild drops an own `__proto__` key and reopening a valid checkpoint then differs from replaying the session log.
Chinese mirror of the lossless-checkpoint note (25 lines); same reader fix and the same "domain version unchanged because the stored representation is unchanged" consequence (line 25).
Archived bilingual-pair sidecar: blob hashes 3375cd5.../4ce4d37... for the lossless-projection pair (lines 5-6).

Creator skills move recipes to `references/` and bundles to `templates/` because SKILL.md had passed the 8192-char tool-result pruner threshold; knowledge sources are ordered (inspect -> README -> built lib/ -> checkout) rather than forbidden, with a test pinning the head budget.
Chinese mirror of the creator-skills note (26 lines); same 8192-char threshold (line 10), same ordered-source rule (line 16), English skeleton headings kept verbatim.
Archived bilingual-pair sidecar: blob hashes 8b0de4a.../c91164d... for the creator-skills pair (lines 5-6).

`Config.listConfigs` reads the live Loader tree and projects a mounted plugin's Schemastery Config into one JSON Schema, replacing the Host `Builtin` provider; the boot-free collector is not re-run because the running profile already holds the resolution interception.
Chinese mirror of the live-config-inspect note (26 lines); same live-provider decision (line 14) and the same limit that runtime-created Agent preset trees stay outside the Loader (line 26).
Archived bilingual-pair sidecar: blob hashes b7a71d3.../c8c90f2... for the live-config-inspect pair (lines 5-6).

Moves `time-context` and `schedule` into the shipped web bundle and enables `ui-schedule`; time-context appends one durable user message per eligible step with the sampled instant, browser zone and elapsed time, and the 12,500-token inline budget now spills the listTools answer head+tail.
Chinese mirror of the web-schedule-composition note (40 lines); same durable time-context message (line 18), same token-cost consequence (line 36), same inline-budget spill (line 39).
Archived bilingual-pair sidecar: blob hashes 3f27bb0.../9e0e1fb... (lines 5-6); the only sidecar here whose re-record command on line 4 omits the target path.
